data.action: 滑坐在长椅旁，双掌撑湿地面，制服保持整齐，看向画面外的同行者。
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level side three-quarter view, bracing hands and bench legs visible
data.description: 暴雨中的公交站避雨亭下，唯刚踩到一片积水，便滑坐在长椅旁，双手撑住湿水泥地面。水手制服领口与裙摆保持整齐，红色风纪袖章有几滴雨水。她看向画面外赶来帮忙的梨斗，又恼又窘——「结城梨斗！先别笑……这里的地面真的很滑！」长椅脚、排水槽和亭外雨帘交代落地点；檐下暖灯照脸与扶地的手，冷雨光和水洼反光延伸到街边。
data.lighting: warm shelter lamp from above left on face and hands; cool rain light beyond the roof
data.location: 雨夜公交避雨亭长椅旁，排水槽接向亭外街边
data.mood: 雨夜意外后的恼羞与松口气
data.promptProse: Yui braces both palms on the wet pavement after slipping beside the bench, looking toward her off-frame companion with her uniform neat. The shelter lamp from above left warms her face and hands against the cool rain beyond the roof.
data.title: 古手川唯 · 雨夜站台的滑步惊魂
data.identityProseOverride: Kotegawa Yui from To LOVE-Ru, the serious disciplinary committee member with long straight black hair, a thin white hairband, golden-brown eyes and an easily flustered expression
